retained.method: One retained unique-word buffer/index per process. Ten warmups and fifteen samples, same model/DOM readiness events. Each sample cancels prior suggestions and requests again, without resetting text or rebuilding the word index.

excludedAttempts: profile*, pilot, final, accepted and scheduled are exploratory or interrupted attempts. final-scheduled and expanded informed the final combined/release rounds; they are not pooled into the final tables.
